
```{r}
crop_poly <- tibble(
  geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(0, 90)), crs = 'EPSG:4326')
) %>%
  st_sf() %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(rts_pt)) %>%
  st_buffer(dist = 5250000) %>%
  smoothr::densify(n = 3) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 'EPSG:4326')

crop_bbox <- crop_poly |>
  st_transform(6931) |>
  st_bbox()

long_lines <- seq(-180, 180, by = 60) %>%
  map(
    ~ long_lines_from_coords(.x, lat_min = st_bbox(crop_poly)[2], lat_max = 90)
  ) %>%
  bind_rows()

lat_lines <- seq(50, 90, by = 10) %>%
  map(~ lat_lines_from_coords(.x, lon_min = -180, lon_max = 180)) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
russia <- world |>

# West Wrangell Island is 29, East Wrangell Island is 31

russia$geometry[31] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(russia$geometry[31], dist = 0.11)

russia <- russia |>
  select(-id)

russia <- russia |>
  summarise(
    geometry = st_union(russia),
```

# New RTS

```{r}
new_rts <- rts_poly |>
  filter(lengths(st_intersects(rts_poly, arts)) == 0)
```

```{r}
shared_rts_modeled <- rts_poly |>
  filter(lengths(st_intersects(rts_poly, arts)) >= 1)

shared_rts_observed <- arts |>
  filter(lengths(st_intersects(arts, rts_poly)) >= 1)
```

```{r}
missed_rts <- arts |>
  filter(lengths(st_intersects(arts, rts_poly)) == 0)
```

# Hex Grid Data Prep

## Create Hex Grid

```{r}
hex_grids <- map(
  c(100000, 50000, 10000),
  ~ domain |>
    st_make_grid(
      cellsize = sqrt((.x * 2) / (sqrt(3))) * 1000, # get short side length of hexagon from area == 100,000 km^2, and convert to m
      square = FALSE
    ) |>
    st_as_sf() |>
    rename(geometry = x) |>
    st_filter(domain) |>
    mutate(idx = 1:n())
)

names(hex_grids) <- c("hex_grid_100k", "hex_grid_50k", "hex_grid_10k")
```

## Extract Counts

Get counts of modeled RTS, observed RTS (ARTS), shared RTS (base: modeled), shared RTS (base: observed/ARTS), new RTS, and missed RTS.

```{r}
hex_grids <- map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ .x |>
    # modeled RTS count
    left_join(
      rts_poly |>
        st_join(.x) |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        mutate(pp = (4 * pi * area_m2) / perimeter_m^2) |>
        summarise(
          rts_modeled_count = n(),
          rts_modeled_area = median(area_m2),
          rts_modeled_pp = median(pp),
          .by = idx
        ),
      by = "idx"
    ) |>
    # observed ARTS count
    left_join(
      arts |>
        st_join(.x) |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        summarise(
          arts_observed_count = n(),
          .by = idx
        ),
      by = "idx"
    ) |>
    # shared RTS count (base:modeled)
    left_join(
      shared_rts_modeled |>
        st_join(.x) |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        summarise(
          shared_rts_modeled_count = n(),
          .by = idx
        ),
      by = "idx"
    ) |>
    # shared RTS count (base:observed/ARTS)
    left_join(
      shared_rts_observed |>
        st_join(.x) |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        summarise(
          shared_rts_observed_count = n(),
          .by = idx
        ),
      by = "idx"
    ) |>
    # new RTS count
    left_join(
      new_rts |>
        st_join(.x) |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        summarise(
          new_rts_count = n(),
          .by = idx
        ),
      by = "idx"
    ) |>
    # missed RTS count
    left_join(
      missed_rts |>
        st_join(.x) |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        summarise(
          missed_rts_count = n(),
          .by = idx
        ),
      by = "idx"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      missed_rts_percent = missed_rts_count / arts_observed_count,
      new_rts_percent = new_rts_count / arts_observed_count,
      modeled_to_observed_ratio = rts_modeled_count / arts_observed_count,
      shared_count_ratio = shared_rts_observed_count / shared_rts_modeled_count,
      rts_modeled_count = case_when(
        is.na(rts_modeled_count) ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ rts_modeled_count
      ),
      arts_observed_count = case_when(
        is.na(arts_observed_count) ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ arts_observed_count
      ),
      .before = geometry
    )
)
```

Take a look at distribution of counts and areas - consider a log scale for color ramps on these.

```{r}
map(
  hex_grids,
  function(.x) {
    list(
      # RTS Count (Modeled)
      ggplot(data = .x) +
        geom_histogram(aes(x = rts_modeled_count)) +
        scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10"),

      # ARTS Count (Observed)
      ggplot(data = .x) +
        geom_histogram(aes(x = arts_observed_count)) +
        scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10")
    )
  }
)
```

# Maps

## Single Variable Maps
Iterate over all hex grid sizes and variables

```{r}
hex_maps <- map2(
  hex_grids,
  hex_domains,
  function(.x, .y) {
    list(
      ### Data Subsets
      # RTS Count (Modeled)
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "rts_modeled_count",
        label = "RTS Count\n(Modeled)",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      # ARTS Count (Observed)
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "arts_observed_count",
        label = "ARTS Count\n(Observed)",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      # Shared RTS Count (base: modeled)
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "shared_rts_modeled_count",
        label = "Shared RTS\nCount\n(Modeled)",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      # Shared RTS Count (base: observed)
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "shared_rts_observed_count",
        label = "Shared RTS\nCount\n(Observed)",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      # New RTS Count
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "new_rts_count",
        label = "New RTS\nCount",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      # Missed RTS Count
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "missed_rts_count",
        label = "Missed RTS\nCount",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      ### Dataset Comparison (Ratios and Percents)
      # Missed RTS percent
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "missed_rts_percent",
        label = "Missed RTS\n(Percent)",
        transformation = "identity"
      ),

      # New RTS Percent
      # Blue means we found more new RTS than we already knew about, red means we found fewer new RTS than we already knew about
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "new_rts_percent",
        color_scale = scale_color_gradient2,
        fill_scale = scale_fill_gradient2,
        label = "New RTS\n(Percent)",
        transformation = "log10"
      ),

      # Modeled to Observed Ratio
      # Blue means we found more RTS (total, not just new) than we already knew about, red means we found fewer RTS (total, not just new) than we already knew about
      map_hex_grid(
        .x,
        .y,
        variable = "modeled_to_observed_ratio",
        color_scale = scale_color_gradient2,
        fill_scale = scale_fill_gradient2,
        label = "Modeled to\nObserved Ratio",
        transformation = "log10"
      )
    )
  }
)

hex_maps
```

# Why are Not-Missed and Shared numbers so different?
Try dividing shared count (observed) by shared count (modeled) and mapping the results to look for places with high values.

```{r}
map2(
  hex_grids,
  hex_domains,
  ~ map_hex_grid(
    .x,
    .y,
    "shared_count_ratio",
    label = "Ratio of Shared RTS Count\n(Observed to Modeled)",
    transformation = "log10"
  )
)

ggplot(hex_grids[["hex_grid_10k"]]) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = rts_modeled_area, y = shared_count_ratio)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10")
```

Following visual inspection of the island in Russia with the exceptionally high value, it looks like our model was an RTS "lumper" while the lab that created the entries for ARTS subscribed to an RTS "splitter" philosophy. The model only identified a few very large RTS along the coast, while the labels split features that are contiguous into sub-RTS with borders that touched (or very nearly so).
